THE HINGE MOVED. The old swing (does Power Innovation convert to in-service EBITDA at ~5x while leverage returns inside 3.5x-4x) was RESOLVED AFFIRMATIVELY at the 2026-08-03 call - Socrates Phase 1 is in service on time and within budget, and the Blackstone JV put forecast leverage back inside the range. The NEW: whether the raised 11%-plus 2025-2030 EBITDA CAGR - which now embeds a $5.5B acquisition struck at ~8.5x and a power platform 49% sold down to partners - converts into PER-SHARE cash returns, given the base business grew only 6% year-over-year in the graded quarter, roi
